Special Characters Test File
============================

1. Basic Special Characters
   !@#$%^&*()_+-=[]{}|;':",./<>?

2. Quotes and Apostrophes
   Single quotes: 'text' 'nested 'quotes' here'
   Double quotes: "text" "nested "quotes" here"
   Backticks: `text` `nested `backticks` here`
   Smart quotes: "curly quotes" 'single curly'

3. Escape Sequences
   Newline: Line1\nLine2
   Tab: Column1\tColumn2
   Backslash: C:\\Users\\Path
   Quote escape: She said \"Hello\"

4. HTML Entities
   Less than: &lt;
   Greater than: &gt;
   Ampersand: &amp;
   Non-breaking space: &nbsp;
   Copyright: &copy;
   Registered: &reg;

5. SQL Injection Patterns
   '; DROP TABLE users; --
   " OR 1=1 --
   ' UNION SELECT * FROM passwords --
   `; DELETE FROM data WHERE 1=1;`

6. XSS Patterns
   <script>alert('XSS')</script>
   <img src=x onerror="alert('XSS')">
   javascript:alert('XSS')
   <svg onload="alert('XSS')">

7. Path Traversal Patterns
   ../../../etc/passwd
   ..\\..\\..\\windows\\system32
   %2e%2e%2f%2e%2e%2f
   ....//....//....//

8. Command Injection Patterns
   ; ls -la
   | whoami
   && cat /etc/passwd
   || rm -rf /

9. Regular Expression Special Characters
   . * + ? ^ $ { } [ ] ( ) | \

10. URL Encoding
    Space: %20
    Equals: %3D
    Ampersand: %26
    Question: %3F

11. Shell Special Characters
    Pipe: |
    Redirect: > < >>
    Background: &
    Variable: $VAR ${VAR}
    Command substitution: $(command) `command`

12. Null and Control Characters
    Null byte: \0
    Bell: \a
    Backspace: \b
    Form feed: \f
    Vertical tab: \v

13. Unicode Special Characters
    Zero-width space: ​
    Zero-width joiner: ‍
    Right-to-left mark: ‏
    Left-to-right mark: ‎

14. File Name Special Cases
    CON PRN AUX NUL (Windows reserved)
    .hidden (Unix hidden file)
    file.txt:stream (NTFS alternate stream)

15. Mixed Encoding Attacks
    %00<script>alert('XSS')</script>
    \x3cscript\x3ealert('XSS')\x3c/script\x3e
    &#60;script&#62;alert('XSS')&#60;/script&#62;

16. Business Logic Special Cases
    -1 (negative numbers)
    0 (zero)
    999999999 (large numbers)
    0.00000001 (small decimals)
    NaN (not a number)
    Infinity
    null
    undefined

17. Time and Date Special Cases
    0000-00-00 00:00:00
    9999-12-31 23:59:59
    1970-01-01 00:00:00 (Unix epoch)
    2038-01-19 03:14:07 (32-bit overflow)

18. Network Special Cases
    127.0.0.1 (localhost)
    0.0.0.0 (all interfaces)
    ::1 (IPv6 localhost)
    255.255.255.255 (broadcast)

19. Email Special Cases
    test@example.com
    test+tag@example.com
    "test@test"@example.com
    test@[127.0.0.1]

20. Comments in Various Languages
    // JavaScript comment
    /* Multi-line comment */
    # Python/Shell comment
    -- SQL comment
    <!-- HTML comment -->
    <%-- JSP comment --%>

End of Special Characters Test File
